name: Run QA tester interactively
summary: Launch qa-tester.sh interactively to start or resume a QA session.
outputs: Interactive menu with options 1-5 and q
prompt: Use this skill when the user wants to start, resume or re-run a QA session. Remind them to have the Jira ticket ID ready.

name: Sync source to QA branch
summary: Clone or fetch+reset the FreeBSD source tree to the QA branch SHA.
risks: Existing dev/src content is overwritten on re-clone
prompt: Use this skill for option 1 of the QA menu. Check whether dev/src already exists to choose fetch+reset (fast) vs fresh clone.

name: Build world + kernel + install
summary: Run make buildworld, buildkernel, installworld, installkernel and schedule nextboot.
outputs: QA kernel installed to /boot/kernel.qa; scheduled for next boot only
prompt: Use this skill for option 2. Warn the user about build time and that a reboot is needed after. The original /boot/kernel is untouched; nextboot(8) schedules kernel.qa for one boot only.

name: Verify running kernel matches QA branch
summary: Check that the running kernel SHA (from uname -v) matches the expected SHA from the QA test file.
outputs: PASS if running SHA matches expected; WARN if checking source tree only (reboot needed)
risks: AMD QA branch SHA format: -<hash>: (no leading g); use sed not tr -d
prompt: Use this skill for option 3. AMD branches embed the SHA as -<7-12 hex>: in uname -v. Fall back to source tree check if no hash found in uname output.

name: Run specific QA tests
summary: Execute the per-ticket QA test script at qa-branches/<QA_ID>/<QA_ID>.sh and generate the report.
commands: # Or via menu: option 4 in qa-tester.sh
outputs: PASS/FAIL counts in results.tsv; full report in qa-report-*.txt
risks: Phase B tests require the QA kernel to be running; verify with option 3 first
prompt: Use this skill for option 4. The test script must exist at qa-branches/<QA_ID>/<QA_ID>.sh. Check the # Branch: and # SHA: headers to confirm the correct source.

name: Send QA report by email
summary: Email the QA report via sendmail/dma to the configured recipients.
commands: # Via menu after running tests: option 5
outputs: MIME multipart email with report as attachment; delivery via dma → atlsmtp10.amd.com
risks: Requires system MTA (dma) configured and network access to atlsmtp10.amd.com
prompt: Default recipients: freebsd-test@mailman-svr.amd.com,ojanerif@amd.com. Sender: freebsd-ci-actions@amd.com. Transport: sendmail → dma → atlsmtp10.amd.com.

name: Create a new QA test script
summary: Author a new qa-branches/<QA_ID>/<QA_ID>.sh test script for a Jira ticket.
outputs: New test script with structured header comments and PASS/FAIL/SKIP helpers
prompt: Every QA script needs: #!/bin/sh, # QA: <ID>, # Branch: <branch>, # SHA: <40-char>, # Upstream PR: <url>. Phase A = build tests (T1-T4). Phase B = runtime tests (T5+) gated on KERNEL_OK. Use POSIX sh only — no bashisms.

name: Check dev-docs vs code drift
summary: Detect source files changed without a matching dev-docs module update.
outputs: List of changed source files whose dev-docs modules were not updated in the same commit
prompt: Run after any code change that lacks a corresponding dev-docs update. Prompt the user to update the relevant module file.
